column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v0.2.0 (commit a18bd1a, tag object 8879377) is the newest published build. The rolling dev
# pre-release (93cb371) and the v0.1.0 tag, which has no GitHub release, hold the same src/ and
# the same core pin (0f7a634). No predecessor repo shipped this mod. No release ZIP or launcher
# manifest shipped or seeded a HeadTracking.ini: every player's file is the one
# config_write_default_if_missing wrote on the first run, edited or not.
# The reader was frozen at 1304bf6. Since v0.2.0 one commit changed how the file is read:
# 443fc59, a LimitYDown that gives no number takes LimitY instead of 0.20. Every core source
# either reader compiles holds the same bytes at 0f7a634 and at the current pin.

column2: the file v0.2.0's config_write_default_if_missing writes (v0.2.0:src/config.cpp lines 165-237, text mode, so CRLF), tests/config_differential/data/first-run-v0.2.0.ini; the test checks the oracle still writes these bytes
